# Determination Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DeterminationStatus`](gmeow-DeterminationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DeterminationStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The status of a musical parameter within a [`DegreeOfFreedom`](gmeow-DegreeOfFreedom.md) relator — fixed, constrained, free, or delegated to performer/environment/process. An open value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

Use [`gmeow:DeterminationStatus`](gmeow-DeterminationStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
